people base what they believe on the information that they gather over their lifetime. This is influenced by precedents, peer pressure, emotions, and ego. it is possible to reduce these, but next to impossible to completely get rid of them. The information that views are based on is also very important.

A way to reduce the amount of erroneous views is to have open dialogue with other people. if your information is wrong its easy for someone else to point it out if they dont have the same limiting factors as you. without challenge, mountains of wrong views can be established as fact in someones mind. this is why safe spaces are so bad for humanity.

I encourage everyone to really look into what you believe and why, and what information it is based on. So many of my old views were based on incomplete information, I assume I still have a lot of incomplete or even wrong information that influences me. Its important to never think that you have mastered something, always assume there is more to learn. The more you know your beliefs and logic, the better dialogue you will have with people of opposing viewpoints. This makes everyone better.
